content: Ema wau moni emo duba-duba inowera amira ge.
O nikare waure zamaire, giu. Yaya-buyaya nisokare nana kei awamunoya, awa giro di toise zawa gateu.

Zebura be tepo wamu inoise inoya, ata saineba, nikare wau bua wetewa be mi poti dara newa itia awa. Waure zamaire nisokare awa yarasa awero tepo wamunoya awa. More tama woire nisokare awa diko meni dara waya wamunora awa. Ota moni nisokare kayai wamunoya. Ago wai kayai ami susu nisokare waya kerenitinoise niao ine wero tama aiso nisokare awero tepo wamunoya awa.

Ninitinowa. Bua mai meni bua nisokare inoise ma gamuwa, ata buara zuma eni ninekare bewana soewa ami zawa gatinoise susu nisokare waya awa kerenitinowia. Ago wawi ma bua wai emara di sai ami utura soldiara Tua amira nana dane toitinowia.
Nikare zebura noise nena zamawi ninoise yawa sara inowewa. Ata nikare nata pu ine. Nikare nena ninoise bamu bazitawa, are azaira be nisokare zora awinoya.
Nikare ema saramai awa gera potiro dawewa betinowera. Ata nukare tama nusokare oko soinowera.
Nakai zewai wero Tua dia nuanekai.
Otao mamai naso, nikare Tua kei awaise, berea tepo dia noiwo. Ninitinowa. Buara mama zo meni ma urero me kei awaise dia nowia. Ago inoise ware waikore te warato ma zewaise, berea tepo, dia nowia.
Da ago ine nikare, Tuara be zora awinoya, are berea tepo dia noise duba nisokare ziwo dopero zewai wae.
Otao mamai, Anutu meni nikare gera potai azu, nikare zuzu ina-sa oko wawe. Ninitinowa. Awina-dawina waira Mama, nu maira be zora awinoya.
Otao mamai naso, porofete meni Tuara bera ge toisowa ami yaya tapinoise berea tepo noisowa, da ago ine nikare te esa nusokare ama ganinoise noiwo.

Ninitinowa. Nukare yayara mokara putoure noisowa awa giro yawa sara wanekai. Ema zazo Yobe zewai nusora ge ninitinowewa. Ota noko ama Tua meni numore zamai tamuro yayara susu kereninua, awa dai ninitinowewa awa. Tua nu awa-diaire dumi yagaba bamure nowia awa.
Ge me sai zewai wai amira ge.

Otao mamai naso, ge zewai zo ewa. Nikare utura ikoniro sai zewai wai o zebura potiro sai zewai wai o nena enira potiro sai zewai wai awa dowo. Ago ine oko wawe. Nikare “Iyo” asamu sero giro “Iyo” gege sewo. Noko “Tepo” asamu sero giro “Tepo” gege sewo. Anutu meni nikare gera potai azu, ago wewo.
Yayare itima ewaana wai amira ge.
Nisokare nana zo meni zo amaire duba naire nuamunoya, nu ami Anutu isa saise. Ota zo meni yawa sarare nuamunoya, nu ami bowi waira yere gamaise.
Nisokare nana zo meni yaya puro itamunoya, nu ami dubura dia zawa sai nuso nana muro nu emo isa sarise. Ago wero Tuara zazo toise amire gawi anarise.
Ago wara tuma diaira isa sai ami yayare awa kora wamunoya. Awa Tua meni nu soremai seka ziro eramunoya. Ota pasina wenuta, awa Tua meni disamunoya.
Are nikare seka ziamu kotumuro giro pasina ina-kerena wero isa meni soga ina-wa wewo. Ema saramai amira isa sai awa putou bamure.
Elia nu ema nakai ine. Are nune wa osai azu, isa zewai-zawai senu zepa etorobarare zora ageware wa zebura kaka osamu itisonua awa.
Ata ama nu isa senu utura ena wa osenu zebura nena we pogi muro eriwa awa.
Ema tara awai awa kora wanakai ewesemare.
Otao mamai naso, nisokare nana zo nu ge mera ebata dainai otao zo meni ziai kapeteniro ebata me patamunoya, awa otao soyamunoya ami ego gaise:
Nu pasina ema zo ebata wayara ena kora wai kapetenamunoya ami ititi nuso betaira ena soero pumamunoya awa. Ago wai Anutu meni pasina nuso witai disamunoya.
